trace.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WHERE ((CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) > 1989 AND (o.name IS NULL OR o.name <> 'Gabe Plotkin and Rick Schnall')) OR (o.name = 'Atlanta Spirit LLC' AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) = 1967))
RETURN DISTINCT c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
